# Programs No named program. Three assistant internships a cycle in 2025 and 2026: product management, inside sales and (2026) marketing


*Last updated: November 2026*


No ASUS internship is open in the US right now. On November 13, 2026, **0 of the 28 openings** on ASUS USA's own Jobvite board were internships. The last cycle's three summer roles, in marketing, product management and inside sales, were on that board in an archived copy from May 16, 2026, but not in one from December 11, 2025. ASUS doesn't publish an open date, so summer 2027 roles are expected sometime in the first half of 2027, based on the 2025 and 2026 postings, with low confidence. In plain words: you apply in early or mid 2027, you intern in summer 2027.


---


## What Is an ASUS Internship?


An ASUS internship in the US is a paid, hourly assistant internship at ASUS Computer International (ASUS USA), the US arm of the Taiwan-based PC and components maker, based in Fremont, California. Interns sit in one business team, not engineering: last cycle's titles were Marketing Assistant, Product Manager Assistant and Inside Sales Assistant, each marked "(Summer Internship)". ASUS posts each role separately on its Jobvite board and has no program page. ASUS's Taiwan Adventurer Star Internship Program is a separate, Taiwan-based program. ASUS doesn't publish a class size or conversion rate.


## When Do ASUS Internship Applications Open for 2027–2028?


ASUS USA runs one small intern intake a year and posts each role on its Jobvite board, but it doesn't publish open dates, deadlines or start dates. Archived copies of the board give the brackets. In 2025, the three internships weren't on the board on March 28, were live by early July, and were gone by August 30. For summer 2026, the three roles weren't there on December 11, 2025 and were live on May 16, 2026. The 2026 roles went up earlier than the 2025 ones, so the calendar isn't stable. Expect summer 2027 postings sometime in the first half of 2027, with low confidence.

*How to read this page: our dates come from tracking previous recruiting cycles and daily posting data. Treat them as informed estimates based on historical patterns, not confirmed dates. The company's official careers page is always the most current source. If a role is posted there, go by that, even if this page suggests the window hasn't opened yet.*


### Why You Must Apply the Week Applications Open


ASUS posts each internship as a single role with no published deadline, and the board shows it only while it's open. In 2025, the three internships were live in July and gone by August 30. With only three roles a cycle and no fixed date, there's no long window to wait out, and a late applicant can find the role already filled. Have your resume and an Excel sample ready by January 2027.

## Which ASUS Internship Programs Should You Target?


ASUS has no named program. The table lists the internships on ASUS USA's own Jobvite board in the last two cycles, from archived copies of the board.


Role Focus Where Last seen


Product Manager Assistant Product orders, market and pricing comparison, go-to-market plans, revenue and margin reports Fremont, CA (hybrid in 2026); City of Industry, CA in 2025 Summer 2026 and 2025


Inside Sales Assistant Customer orders, shipments, backorder lists and weekly sales reports Fremont, CA (hybrid in 2026) Summer 2026 and 2025


Marketing Assistant Marketing team support Fremont, CA Summer 2026


When roles go live, they appear on[ASUS USA's Jobvite board](https://jobs.jobvite.com/asus/jobs) under Marketing, Product Management or Sales. Full-time roles such as Associate Product Manager or Assistant System Analyst aren't internships.


## What Are the Eligibility Requirements?


No ASUS internship posting is open to read. These are the requirements in ASUS's own 2025 postings; check each 2027 posting, since they may change.


• **Class year:** "Currently enrolled in 3rd year of 4 year college or above" (Inside Sales Assistant, 2025); the Fremont Product Manager Assistant role also took recent graduates of a 4-year college.


• **GPA:** 3.2 or higher on two 2025 roles; 3.5 or higher on the City of Industry Product Manager Assistant role.


• **Languages:** fluent English required; Mandarin "preferred" or "a plus" on two of the three 2025 roles.


• **Tools:** Microsoft Office, "especially Excel including V-Lookup and Pivot Tables" (Inside Sales Assistant, 2025).


• **Work authorization and sponsorship:** not published.


### Is the GPA a Hard Cutoff?


ASUS's 2025 postings listed GPA under required qualifications, not preferred ones, so treat 3.2 as the floor for those roles. ASUS hasn't published 2027 requirements, so read the qualifications on each new posting.

Based on 403 software engineering interns who started their first software internship between 2024 and 2026 (public LinkedIn profiles, aggregated). Six questions, under a minute.


** ** ** ** ** **


Question 1 of 6


#### Which summer are you applying for?


Recruiting timelines differ by class year, so we compare you with the right group.


Question 2 of 6


#### Which group is your school closest to?


Firms recruit on campus in tiers. We match you against admits from schools like yours.


Question 3 of 6


#### Is your major computer science, software engineering, data science or electrical engineering?


Almost every software intern in our data studied one of these. Other majors get in, but the coursework has to show elsewhere.


Question 4 of 6


#### How many internships, externships or research positions have you held so far?


Count anything with a real employer, mentor or principal investigator attached. Retail and food service do not count.


Question 5 of 6


#### Has any of that experience been tech-related?


Software, data, IT, engineering or a research lab. Any size of company counts.


Question 6 of 6

Personal, class, hackathon or open-source projects all count.

## What Skills Does ASUS Look For, and How Do You Build Them?


The skills come from ASUS's own 2025 postings, the last ones with readable descriptions. **Product and market analysis:** Product Manager Assistants "Perform market analysis and comparison for products, pricing and channels" and "Prepare new product go-to-market plan". **Numbers and reporting:** the same role asked for "monthly revenue/margin analysis and forecast", and Inside Sales asked for Excel "including V-Lookup and Pivot Tables". **Operations and customers:** both roles track orders and shipments and work with sales, warehouse and customers, so organization and clear English matter, with Mandarin as a plus.


> **Note:** No skill chart for ASUS: no intern posting is open, and only three of ASUS's own intern job descriptions (2025) can still be read, too few to count. We'll add a chart when the summer 2027 roles post.

## What Is the ASUS Application and Interview Process Like?


ASUS doesn't publish its intern interview process. This is what its own board shows.


1. **Find the role.** On careers.asus.com choose United States, which opens ASUS USA's Jobvite board. Interns are titled "Assistant (Summer Internship)" under Marketing, Product Management or Sales.


2. **Apply on Jobvite.** Apply to each role separately with your resume. Apply only through this board.


3. **Check the requirements.** Last cycle's postings named class year, GPA and Excel skills, so make them easy to find on your resume.


4. **Interview and decision.** ASUS doesn't publish the number of rounds, the questions or decision dates.


Until roles post in 2027, the useful work is preparing your resume and an Excel sample.

## How Do You Stand Out for an ASUS Internship?


First, show spreadsheet skill: ASUS's 2025 postings asked for Excel with VLOOKUPs and pivot tables, and for monthly revenue and margin analysis, so bring a sample. Second, know the products: the Product Manager Assistant role compares products, prices and channels, so be ready to talk about ASUS laptops, components or monitors against rivals. Third, if you speak Mandarin, say so, since two 2025 roles listed it as a plus. ASUS doesn't publish a class size, applicant count or conversion rate.

## FAQ


### Can I still apply for a summer 2026 ASUS internship?


No. As of November 2026, no ASUS internship is open in the US: 0 of 28 openings on ASUS USA's Jobvite board were internships on November 13. Last cycle's three summer roles went up between mid-December 2025 and mid-May 2026, so summer 2027 roles are expected in the first half of 2027.


### When do ASUS internship applications open?


ASUS doesn't publish a date. Archived copies of its board show the 2026 roles appeared between December 11, 2025 and May 16, 2026, and the 2025 roles between late March and early July 2025. So we expect summer 2027 postings in the first half of 2027, with low confidence. Check the board from January.


### Are ASUS internships paid?


Yes, by the hour. ASUS's own 2025 postings listed $17.75 an hour in Fremont and $17.87 an hour in City of Industry, California. A ZipRecruiter copy of the 2026 Marketing Assistant posting listed $18.05 an hour in Fremont, which isn't an official figure. ASUS hasn't published 2027 pay.


### Who can apply for an ASUS internship?


In 2025, ASUS asked for current college students in their 3rd year or above, with a GPA of 3.2 or higher; one role asked for 3.5, and one also took recent graduates. Fluent English was required and Mandarin was a plus. Work authorization rules aren't published. Check each 2027 posting.


### Where are ASUS internships located?


In Fremont, California, at ASUS USA's headquarters. One 2025 Product Manager Assistant role was in City of Industry, California. The 2026 product and inside sales roles were listed as hybrid remote in Fremont, while 2025 product roles said office only. ASUS hasn't posted a fully remote internship.


### Does ASUS offer engineering internships in the US?


Not in the last two cycles. ASUS USA's 2025 and 2026 internships were all business roles: product management, inside sales and marketing assistants. Its US board does post full-time engineering jobs. The Adventurer Star Internship Program, which includes hardware and AI fields, is run in Taiwan and is a separate application.


ASUS's summer 2027 roles are expected in the first half of 2027, so set up your board checks now. A[remote Externship](https://www.extern.com/externships) gives you a product, finance or data project to show when they post.
